items.title: Bob Shoffner Interview, 1959-09-08
items.q: That was, my time was Scott Joplin and Tom Turpin.

ctx.x: When you were a boy, do you remember any of the ragtime players around there? Like Scott Joplin?
Well, during that time, yeah, that was. That was, my time was Scott Joplin and Tom Turpin.
Oh. Do you remember Louis Chauvin by any chance?
